scope: POST-EXPOSURE FACTORIAL ABLATION on already inspected original and matched-comparator streams. No new simulation, new domain or independent confirmation.
preservation: Copy three original method rows unchanged in numerical value; add absolute_variance from signed_variance using the original stored absolute allowance. No RNG is called by analysis.
grid: Entire original grid: both designs; five signals[-.125,0,.125,.25,.5]; groups25,100,400,1600; estimated fits with512/8192validation pairs; two-category opposed shifts with8192pairs. Keep all100settings including40nonpositive settings.
absolute_definition: Exactly original weighted_category_bias_budget: coordinate intervals at delta/2, cell e_c=max(|lv-f|,|uv-f|)*max(|lw-g|,|uw-g|), maximize sum p_c e_c subject to same p_c upper binomial caps and simplex. Not max|sum p d|, a worst-cell maximum, empirical category weights, or a changed validation event.
variance_definition: Same full grouped-U center and disjoint-triple sample variance, J=M*floor(N/3), fitted kernel range, factor2 inversion and deterministic Hoeffding cap as original signed_variance; change only bias allowance.
paired_ci: For plus/minus discordant counts, separate two-sided97.5%Clopper-Pearson intervals; subtract endpoints. Bonferroni ensures at least95%coverage for paired probability difference. Pointwise per fixedsetting/contrast, not independent-proportions or McNemar CI; no simultaneous-grid claim.
interaction: (signed_variance-absolute_variance)-(signed_range-absolute_range) per paired binary decision; ternary because signed allowance is pointwise no larger. Same discordant-probability interval.
continuous_attribution: Lower-bound gain equals absolute-minus-signed allowance plus range-minus-variance radius pointwise. Thresholded power can interact; report both factor orders and their average, never uniquely assign overlapping decisions.
average_factor_ci: Pointwise Hoeffding on paired per-replication order-averaged factors, support[0,1] for learning and[-1,1] for sampling; descriptive grid sums have no pooled-binomial CI.
classical_context: Retain original original independent_triples/pooled_variance summaries. Secondary matched300-prefix uses all32existing matched-comparator settings and existing comparator methods independent_bernstein,independent_betting,pooled_variance,pooled_betting together with factorial four; no extension of that grid.
independent_verifier: No analysis/producer imports. Recompute all rows, CI endpoints using direct binomial inversion, and selected original primitive validation blocks with generic numeric comparisons and scipy LP.

preexecution_revision.note: Before any run_started/results, corrected summary serialization so test-only betting comparators report coverage as unavailable, not as failures. Scientific design unchanged. Initial code/protocol retained.
